voice.summary: Orbit Studio writes like a small studio that prefers to be useful rather than loud. Copy is short, plainly confident and ready to step aside so the work can speak.
dos: Start with the work and the person it helps
Use plain verbs: shape, build, ship
donts: Do not list tools or frameworks in the intro

taglines: Design that gets out of the way
Better things to do? Us too
boilerplate: Orbit Studio is a small design and engineering studio that builds quiet, useful software for people who have better things to do.
